purpose: Human-reviewable product acceptance evals for core Pravaas guest, hotel, and platform workflows. These are scenario definitions, not claims that automated end-to-end tests already exist.

evaluation_rules.pass: Expected behavior is observed in the target environment and evidence is recorded.
evaluation_rules.fail: Behavior contradicts an expectation or causes data loss, unsafe access, or a broken primary flow.
evaluation_rules.blocked: Cannot evaluate because required service, account, fixture, permission, or environment is unavailable.

preconditions: Approved canonical logo asset is available
steps: Open the homepage and auth pages
Inspect browser favicon and Apple/PWA install icon
Install or refresh the PWA where supported
expected: All surfaces use the approved Pravaas logo and consistent brand treatment
Icons are legible at small sizes and have no unrelated generated mark
No broken image requests or stale cached icon remains after version/cache refresh
Valid sign-in reaches the correct authenticated experience
Sign-out clears the authenticated session
Invalid credentials show a useful error and do not authenticate

preconditions: Test identities for each role exist
steps: Attempt to open a route and call an API outside that role's permissions
expected: Only permitted routes and actions are available
Server-side authorization rejects unauthorized API access regardless of UI visibility

preconditions: Hotel test account and required KYG/C-form fixtures are available
steps: Try submitting with required fields missing
expected: Valid data is saved and visible after reopening
Missing required data is clearly identified
Sensitive guest/hotel data is not exposed to unrelated accounts

preconditions: Authorized hotel account and synthetic guest data
steps: Create or open a guest C-form record
Verify record access with an unrelated account
expected: Valid records persist with correct status
Validation prevents malformed submissions
Access is restricted to authorized users; errors do not leak sensitive data

steps: Inspect booking in guest history and hotel view
expected: Booking details and status remain consistent across views
Refresh does not duplicate a booking
Status labels are readable and consistent

preconditions: At least three dated synthetic trips exist
expected: Records are sorted newest to oldest
Missing dates do not crash the screen
Status labels remain legible in light and dark themes if supported
Saved itinerary is discoverable from a clear entry point
Saved content persists across navigation/reload according to product design
Opening it restores the expected itinerary details

preconditions: Explore data or fallback state is available
steps: Repeat with empty/error data if available
expected: Cards expose the intended action and respond to taps/clicks
Empty and error states are understandable
Layout remains usable on narrow screens

preconditions: AI service configured or deterministic mock available
steps: Submit an unrelated or empty prompt
expected: Response matches the user's intent and avoids presenting guesses as verified facts
Empty input is handled safely
Service failure produces a recoverable message

preconditions: Drive mode feature flag enabled and test location/route available
expected: Enabled mode is reachable and core controls work
Disabled mode is hidden or gracefully unavailable
Permission denial does not crash the app and explains the limitation

preconditions: Flags FEATURE_EXPLORE_ENABLED, FEATURE_REEL_TO_ITINERARY_ENABLED, FEATURE_COMMUNITY_ENABLED and Drive mode flag configured
steps: Test unset or malformed flag value
expected: Enabled features appear and work
Disabled features are gated without breaking navigation
Defaults are safe and consistent with the documented product decision

steps: Check homepage, auth, booking, history and hotel screens at mobile and desktop widths
expected: No horizontal overflow, clipped primary actions, or overlapping dialogs
Keyboard focus and labels remain usable
Loading, empty, error, and success states are distinguishable

steps: Run configured lint/typecheck/build checks on the PR
expected: All configured required checks pass
Failures identify the command and relevant logs
No check is reported as passing if it was skipped or could not run
